Slide 1: Problem - Restaurants waste 8 to 14 percent of purchased food.
Slide 2: Product - Hourly prep forecasting integrated into kitchen workflows.
Slide 3: Traction - 58 paying locations, 118 percent NRR, 26 percent waste reduction in pilots.
Slide 4: GTM - Channel partnerships with POS integrators and regional distributors.
Slide 5: Ask - Raising 2.5 million dollars for 18-month plan to 400 locations.
